advancements.mowziesmobs.sculptor_failur: Fall to your death during the Sculptor's challenge
No One Jumps for the Beef
effect.mowziesmobs.eclipsed.description: Prevents all other status effects while active.
effect.mowziesmobs.frozen.description: Prevents all actions for a short duration. Fire damage will remove the effect early.
effect.mowziesmobs.geomancy.description: Allows you to command the power of the earth.
effect.mowziesmobs.sunblock.description: A small boost to regeneration and damage resistance.
effect.mowziesmobs.suns_blessing.descrip: Allows you to command the power of the sun.
entity.mowziesmobs.sculptor.trade.button:
Reach the top of the course and right-click the Sculptor to pass!
Placing blocks, breaking blocks, teleporting, and flying are not allowed.
item.mowziesmobs.bluff_rod.text.0: Use to repair Geomancy items, or give to the Sculptor to begin his challenge
item.mowziesmobs.earthrend_gauntlet.text:
§lBoulder Lift§r§7
Right-click earthen ground to lift a boulder
Punch boulder to fire it as projectile
Charge right-click to lift bigger boulders

§lTunnel§r§7
Right-click the air to start tunneling through the ground
Hold right-click and look in the direction you'd like to dig
Release right-click to surface and stop tunneling

§lPillar Rise§r§7
Hold both Sneak and Jump to rise upward on a pillar of earth
The pillar's width increases if it grows through geomancy boulders
item.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_crescent.te: Use to inflict Fragility on nearby mobs
Fragility increases damage received from attacks
item.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_full.text.0: Use to inflict Weakness on nearby mobs
item.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_gibbous.tex: Use to inflict Slowness on nearby mobs
item.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_half.text.0: Use to inflict Mining Fatigue on nearby mobs
item.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_new.text.0: Use to inflict Eclipse on nearby mobs
item.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_new.text.1: Eclipse clears and prevents all status effects
item.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_new.text.2: Eclipsed status effects are restored when Eclipse ends
item.mowziesmobs.geomancer_beads.text.0: +3 attack when punching (including attacks with the Earthrend Gauntlet)
item.mowziesmobs.geomancer_belt.text.0: +4 armor and +1 knockback resist while you are inflicted with Slowness
item.mowziesmobs.geomancer_robe.text.0: Chance to spawn a geomancy boulder nearby when you deal or take damage
Gain increased movement speed for 3 seconds after falling more than 4 blocks
item.mowziesmobs.sand_rake.text.0:
Use on sand to create raked patterns
Repair with wood planks
item.mowziesmobs.sculptor_staff.text.0: Spawns three small rocks that fire as projectiles after a delay
item.mowziesmobs.sculptor_staff.text.1: Look in the direction you want the rocks to fire, then right-click
